basic_only_policy.decision: S9.2 Basic/Extended policy: every resistor and capacitor is a Basic part except the documented electrical exceptions R2/R3 (0.1 % UVLO), R93/R94/R98/R99 (0.1 % guard dividers) and R109 (18 mOhm 1 W metal-alloy shunt, no Basic part exists). ICs, transistors, TVS/Schottky diodes, the inductors and connectors are Extended where JLCPCB has no Basic equivalent. Every machine-assembled part has a C-code with live stock at the dated audit; alternates are recorded in the Alternates field. J2/J3 (box headers) and D8 (panel LED) stay owner-fitted manual parts by the S7/S8 module policy; JLCPCB THT codes are noted for them.
basic_only_policy.why: Precision UVLO gives the worst-case start < 13 V; precision guard dividers keep the overvoltage margins; the 18 mOhm shunt sets the 2.62-2.95 A CC limit (Kelvin land).
